summary: Iteration 6 backend + frontend testing of 3 new features: (1) Import Voti Guidato (dry_run preview), (2) Esporta Storico PDF, (3) Notifiche Automatiche (background loop + deadline endpoints). Backend: 18/18 pytest PASSED in ~14s (test_iter6_features.py) — includes admin & player login, /api/export/pdf 200 application/pdf (admin), 403 (player), 401/403 (unauth), garbage-PDF dry_run returns 400 with Italian detail message, dry_run=false&replace=true params accepted (no 422), non-admin voti upload → 403, deadlines list returns 38 slots, PUT/GET future deadline round-trip works, backend stays healthy after ops (auto-notify loop did not crash startup). Frontend: admin login OK, /admin panel shows new 'Import Voti (PDF / Excel) — con anteprima' section with data-testid admin-pdf + admin-xlsx; uploading a garbage PDF correctly shows NO preview rows (voti-row-0 and voti-confirm both absent, backend returns 400 as expected). SurvivalDetail /survival/{id} renders without runtime errors; svd-export-pdf click triggers POST /api/export/pdf → 200 application/pdf. ScoreAndLiveDetail sald-export-pdf click also → 200 application/pdf. FantaGiornata league page redirects to /hub for admin (admin not a member of any league) — could not exercise fgl-export-pdf via UI, but code path is identical to the two working buttons (same apiDownload helper + same backend endpoint verified by tests). Hub shows 4+1 game cards. No critical bugs found.

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise via UI because the QA admin account is not a member of any FG league (opening /fantagiornata/{id} silently redirects to /). Non-blocking — backend /api/export/pdf verified 200 application/pdf and same apiDownload helper works for SV+SAL variants.

critical_code_review_comments: Auto-notify loop in server.py (_auto_notify_loop) correctly guards against crashing startup: wrapped in try/except with 5-min sleep. Silently marks past deadlines as open_notified — matches the stated design.
exports.py /export/pdf uses local imports for reportlab (fine), StreamingResponse with Content-Disposition — good.
matchday_facts.py dry_run branch now includes 'rows' key when parsing succeeds — verified by code inspection (line 352). Cannot execute happy-path without a real Voti PDF fixture; 400-path exercised.
apiDownload helper in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js correctly creates a blob URL and triggers download via anchor click; error path throws with extracted message.
Admin.js voti preview flow: previewVoti sends dry_run=true and shows rows only when rows.length > 0 — verified: garbage PDF → 400 → no preview shown (correct).
